description: Defines the MessageString class which encapsulates message details, including fields for message text, related fields, error status, locale, and source error, along with static methods for filtering messages by fields.

classes.name: MessageString
classes.description: A class representing a message with associated metadata such as field name, locale, error status, and source error, including static methods for message filtering.

methods.name: getMessagesForField
methods.description: Filters a list of message objects to include only those associated with specified field(s), optionally converting to string representations.

methods.name: isForField
methods.description: Checks if the message is associated with a given field name or set of field names.
